title: d48a3cfd/T3: Strassen–Winograd recursion + bound propagation
description:
Third task of story `d48a3cfd`. Adds Strassen–Winograd recursive matrix multiplication on top of T1's classical blocked `gemm`.

## Deliverables

- **Strassen–Winograd recursion** per Dumas–Pernet §1.4, algorithm 1.6 — 7 recursive multiplications, 15 block additions.
- **Bound propagation** through sub-problems per theorem 4: `|z| ≤ ((1+3^l)/2)² · ceil(k/2^l) · (p−1)²`. Recursion must respect this when choosing whether to reduce.
- **Threshold gating**: `WINO_THRESHOLD` configurable per field. Below threshold, dispatch to T1's classical `gemm`.
- **Criterion benches at n = 2048, 4096** for GF(2^31-1) and GF(2^8), showing Winograd beats classical past the threshold.

## Success criteria

- [hard] Winograd path produces bit-exact results vs. classical path at all sizes around the threshold (including exactly at the threshold, +1, −1).
- [hard] Bound propagation verified with a property test: random matrices, Winograd vs. classical, every intermediate's value within the theorem-4 bound.
- [hard] Threshold tuned empirically; recorded in the bench output.
- [hard] Tests cover m, k, n odd (non-power-of-2 splits) — Winograd's recursive halving must handle padding.
- [aspirational] Winograd beats classical at the measured threshold by ≥ 1.2× on at least one field.

## Depends on

- `d48a3cfd/T1` (classical `gemm` is the base case).
